Frontend: anonymous /tv/s3a-smoke-karak renders full-bleed kiosk with all required testids (station-tv-page[data-page-type=business_radio], tv-verified-chip, tv-open-now-badge, tv-qr-panel[data-qr-target=https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.com/r/s3a-smoke-karak], tv-qr-code, tv-track-title/artist, tv-progress-bar, tv-announcement-ticker[data-count=3]); sidebar/topbar/miniplayer ALL absent. /tv/p41-audit-test renders personal_radio kiosk (no verified chip, no address row, ticker-empty). /tv/does-not-exist renders tv-error-screen 'Station not found'. Non-owner /r/s3a-smoke-karak: manager absent (PASS), CTA visible (PASS). Owner /r/p41-audit-test (personal): manager absent (PASS), CTA visible (PASS).

issues: The only seeded playable track 'P42 Healthy Fixture' has duration_sec=30, while the kiosk slot is 180s. This means the progress bar reaches 100% within 30s of every 3-min slot and stays pinned at 100% for the remaining 150s. The 1Hz tick implementation IS correct (verified via main agent screenshot 53%->67%); this is a data/seeding issue rather than a code bug. Recommend either (a) clamping/looping progress to slot_seconds instead of duration_sec when the track is shorter than the slot, OR (b) seeding a longer demo track.

Starts at / Ends at fields use the browser's native HTML5 datetime-local picker (placeholder mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --) rather than a shadcn calendar. Per code-review guideline this is a minor design inconsistency vs the rest of the app's shadcn-based pickers. Not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Clamp/loop the TV progress bar's denominator to the smaller of duration_sec and slot_seconds, OR fallback to slot_seconds when duration_sec < slot_seconds, so the bar visibly cycles every 3 min instead of saturating at 100% for 150s/180s with the seeded 30s track.
OPTIONAL: Swap the native HTML5 datetime input in AnnouncementManager for the shadcn calendar/popover to keep visual parity with the rest of the wizard UIs.
critical_code_review_comments: station_tv.py:182-189 active_count loop iterates ALL station_announcements with no count cap; OK for ≤10 cap but could project a $match + count_documents to avoid streaming. Negligible at current scale.
station_tv.py:46 in-process _TV_CACHE is per-worker; with multiple uvicorn workers each worker caches independently — fine for an 8s window but worth noting for ops.
_pick_now_playing_track fetches up to 500 tracks into memory each call; mitigated by 8s cache, but consider an indexed sample for larger libraries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all assertions; progress-bar +1 tick not observable in current data due to 30s track vs 180s slot saturation (not a code defect)
